reference.kind: gdaldem (real GDAL library code, not a reimplementation)
reference.entryPoint: GDALDEMProcessing from the libgdal bundled in the rasterio wheel, called through ctypes

edgePolicy: gdaldem default: outer ring and any window containing a nodata (NaN) sample is nodata (ours: borderMode "nodata"). -compute_edges is not mapped: our borderMode "clamp" replicates the edge sample, GDAL extrapolates 2a-b, so edge values differ by design.
nodataPolicy: null = nodata (GDAL -9999 / Byte 0 / NaN input). Aspect on flat cells is nodata in GDAL and -1 in ours.

conventionMap.cellSize: geotransform pixel size (x, |y|) <-> settings[0], settings[1], rowDirection "south"
conventionMap.slope: degrees atan(|grad|/scale) <-> slopeUnits "degrees"; -p percent <-> slopeUnits "percent"; GDAL -s scale divides the gradient, so ours zFactor = 1/scale
conventionMap.aspect: degrees clockwise from north of the downslope direction, [0,360) <-> atan2(-east,-north); flat: GDAL nodata, ours -1. GDAL QUIRK: GDALAspectAlg does not divide the Horn sums by xres/yres, so on non-square cells its aspect is the angle of the unscaled gradient, not the physical one (verified by hand on nonsquare-17x13). The aspect variant therefore records ours.cellSizeOverride [1,1] to reproduce GDAL; ours keeps the physical aspect for real cell sizes.
conventionMap.hillshade: GDAL -z z-factor <-> zFactor, -az <-> azimuthDegrees, -alt <-> altitudeDegrees; GDAL Byte (1 + 254 shade) decoded to [0,1]; shade <= 0 decodes to 0 in both
conventionMap.algorithm: GDAL default -alg Horn <-> ours 3x3 Sobel / 8 (identical kernel)

cases.name: analytic-17x13
cases.description: Analytic sinusoid plus tilt plus seeded noise, square 10 m cells

slopeDegrees.derivation: GDAL f32 output ulp (<=1e-5 deg) + kernel: 8*|z|max(264)*2^-24/(8*cellMin) = 1.57e-06 slope-units, x4 for f32 trig

slopePercent.derivation: 100 * gradient error x4 (percent = 100 tan(slope), derivative of tan stays below 4 for slope < 60 deg)

aspectDegrees.derivation: angle error ~ gradient error / |gradient| <= 1e-5/0.05 rad = 0.012 deg; compared (circularly) only where |gradient| >= 0.05

hillshade.derivation: GDAL writes Byte 1 + 254*shade, one level = 1/254 = 3.94e-3; f32 kernel error < 4e-5
